text:
anna: quick report: sample app shows mixed auth headers when we rotate RW_API_KEY during warmup. intermittent 401s.

tom: are you using module-level client or creating per-request?

anna: module-level client imported from sample. I changed env in my test harness and observed logs where retry used new key but original attempt used old.

riyad: sounds like client caches header at one point but retry path re-reads provider. that's inconsistent.

anna: repro snippet attached in issue.

ci-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/3822 (area:auth, bug)

tom: short-term guidance: avoid mutating os.environ in running servers; construct client explicitly with api_key=os.getenv("RW_API_KEY") at startup or recreate client on key change.

riyad: medium-term: SDK should accept ApiKeyProvider = Union[str, Callable[[], str], Callable[[], Awaitable[str]]] plus a flag resolve_on_request. Also add client.refresh_credentials() and ensure retry middleware builds per-attempt headers from provider without mutating session-global headers.

anna: agree. also add typing helpers in py. PR should include concurrency unit tests to prevent regressions.

tom: I'll pick up a small docs patch for the quickstart to clarify env vs explicit. assigning to me.

anna: thanks — I'll paste failing log snippet into the issue now.
